title: Positive etale object cohomology classes vanish on Zariski neighbourhoods
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] whose local rings are strictly henselian [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology]. Let i from its small Zariski site [def-sc-zariski-site] to its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] be a functor whose underlying scheme functor is the open-restriction functor. Let F be an abelian etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], q>0, U an open, and xi in H^q(i(U),F), with object cohomology and restrictions as in [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. For every point x in U, there is an open V containing x with V contained in U such that the restriction of xi along i(V)->i(U) is zero. Cohomology may be encoded in any Ext universe for which HasExt is supplied; the coefficient category is AddCommGrpCat in the scheme morphism universe.

source.place: Tag 09AX (lemma-local-rings-strictly-henselian), proof, third and fourth sentences; Tags 03Q6 and 03QO, with the section-complex/Ext comparison in Cohomology on Sites 03F3.

proof.text: Write q=n+1. Apply the object-cohomology stalk-complex comparison, obtaining an injective resolution I of F and an additive equivalence e between the lifted cohomology colimit and H^(n+1)(E(I)).

Mathlib supplies preservation of finite limits by E. Apply the strictly henselian section-epimorphism theorem at x. Preservation of epimorphisms and kernels implies preservation of homology. Since I is exact in degree n+1, its image under E has zero homology in that degree.
The target of e is a zero abelian group, hence a subsingleton. Its injectivity shows that the coprojections of the given lifted class and zero at the neighbourhood (U,hx) are equal.

The forgetful functor on abelian groups preserves filtered colimits. Shrink this preservation to the neighbourhood universe, without fixing the implicit Ext universe. The concrete filtered-colimit equality criterion gives a common later object V and a map from U killing the class. V is contained in U and contains x; apply ULift.down to get the original restriction equality.

lean.statement:
theorem strictHenselian_cohomology_locally_zero
    {X : Scheme.{u + 1}}
    (hX : ∀ x : X, IsStrictlyHenselianLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (i : X.Opens ⥤ X.Etale)
    (hi_inclusion : i ⋙ Scheme.Etale.forget X = X.restrictFunctor)
    [HasSheafify X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    [HasExt (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (U : X.Opens)
    (ξ : (i.op ⋙ Sheaf.cohomologyPresheaf F q).obj (op U))
    (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    ∃ (V : X.Opens) (hVU : V ≤ U), x ∈ V ∧
      (i.op ⋙ Sheaf.cohomologyPresheaf F q).map (homOfLE hVU).op ξ = 0
